title: Traditional Games
text:
Many children play traditional games. One popular game is hopscotch. Players draw a grid of boxes on the ground with chalk. They throw a stone into the boxes and jump on one foot.

Another game is marbles. Children use small glass balls. They try to hit the other marbles. The winner keeps the marbles that they hit.

questions.text: What do players draw on the ground in hopscotch?
What do children use in the game of marbles?
Why do players jump on one foot in hopscotch?
options: Because they must move through the boxes

questions.text: What is the main goal of the marbles game?
options: To hit the other marbles and win them

vocabulary.definition: done in the same way for a long time
a soft stick used to write or draw on the ground
small balls used in a game
a small hard piece of rock

paragraph_translations: Muchos niños juegan juegos tradicionales. Un juego popular es la rayuela. Los jugadores dibujan una cuadrícula de cuadros en el suelo con tiza. Lanzan una piedra a los cuadros y saltan en un pie.
Otro juego son las canicas. Los niños usan pequeñas bolas de vidrio. Intentan golpear las otras canicas. El ganador se queda con las canicas que golpea.
